name: Animaker
tagline: Animaker is a browser-based animated video creation platform with a vast library of characters, backgrounds, and props. Its AI features include an AI-powered voiceover generator with 200+ voices in 50 languages, auto lip-sync, and an AI video script assistant. HR and marketing teams use it for onboarding and explainer videos.
